journey.name: Mark Playing Episode as Played with Queued Items
journey.description: Verifies that when an episode is actively playing and another episode is in the queue, marking the playing episode as played advances playback to the next episode in the queue.

actions.action: Verify that the app is on the Home screen and episodes are visible.
Tap the "Add to queue" button on the second episode in the list.
Tap the "Play" button on the first episode in the list to start playback.
Verify that the mini-player bar at the bottom is visible and actively playing the first episode.
Tap the three-dots menu icon on the first episode.
Verify that the first episode stops playing and the mini-player advances to actively playing the second (queued) episode.
